Obsidian arrow

Internal ID: ArrowObsidian | Type: Arrow | Source: Workbench | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Obsidian x4, Feathers x2

Introduction. Obsidian arrows are ammunition for bows and are a direct upgrade from Ironhead arrows.

Availability. • Obsidian can be found in the Mountain biome; it requires an Iron pickaxe to mine.
• These arrows can be crafted at a Workbench.
